reason: The specimens are secured and the ascent path is clear, so I'll use the only offered action to command ascent.
expectation: I expect the switch to initiate ascent, though I don't know how the departure will unfold.

effect: The ascent succeeded, leaving the repaired lower stage behind and completing the chapter.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the cave and solar panels recede together, though the command itself was the only available action.

mostWorthwhile.text: Starting ascent was worthwhile for its view of the expedition's home and equipment shrinking below, bringing the departure into focus.

leastWorthwhile.text: The switch action offered no meaningful decision beyond taking the only available option.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; ascent was the expected result.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt arbitrary: using the guarded console switch to command ascent had a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would personally continue to see what happens to the specimens after rendezvous; this chapter closes the surface journey but leaves their investigation open.
